retention_trigger: Later of academic-term end, final grade/feedback dispute resolution, or legal-hold release
purpose: Preserve assignment feedback long enough for learning review and disputes, then minimize student coursework copies.
review_notes: Do not delete disputed feedback or material incorporated into a grade appeal, academic record, research protocol, or legal hold.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm that EdNotebook is a convenience copy rather than the official grade-appeal record.

retention_trigger: Later of academic-term end, student export window, or legal-hold release
purpose: Give students an export and recovery window while limiting retention of unfinished student coursework.
review_notes: Student-controlled deletion may occur earlier when no dispute, hold, submission dependency, or research protocol applies.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm course-work classification and the student export notice.

retention_trigger: Later of academic-term end, final dispute resolution, research-protocol completion, or legal-hold release
purpose: Retain submitted coursework through the institutional course-work window and then securely dispose of the copy.
review_notes: If a submission is the official grade evidence or research data, route it to that longer-lived record class before disposal.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm EdNotebook record-copy status and research-routing behavior.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until event classes are segregated
record_series: Mixed FERPA access / ASU 1.2/010 / security audit
purpose: Prevent destruction of disclosure, disposition, security, and governance evidence that can carry different retention periods.
review_notes: One undifferentiated audit domain cannot safely use one period: FERPA disclosure logs follow the underlying education record, while disposition logs are ten years.
unresolved_dependency: Split audit events by record class or approve a longest-applicable retention rule.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until student-status-specific account rules are represented
purpose: Avoid deleting active identities or retaining departed-user account data beyond the applicable student-status window.
review_notes: ASU uses different windows for applicants, admitted students, undergraduates, graduate students, and graduates; one domain-wide day count is unsafe.
unresolved_dependency: Implement status-aware triggers and confirm whether identity metadata is an official access record.

retention_trigger: Provider log expiry plus verified export/hold handling
purpose: Keep authentication evidence only for the approved security and incident-response window while respecting provider-controlled expiry.
review_notes: Provider plan retention and local Postgres audit-log storage are separate. Legal/security holds need a governed export path before provider expiry.
unresolved_dependency: Document current Supabase plan TTL, database-log setting, export procedure, and hold exception.

retention_trigger: Session expiry or revocation, whichever occurs first
purpose: Remove expired authentication session material promptly while retaining only the minimum operational troubleshooting window.
review_notes: Revoke immediately on account closure or compromise; the 30-day period applies only to non-secret session metadata, never reusable tokens.
unresolved_dependency: Verify Supabase Auth session cleanup and token revocation behavior.

retention_trigger: Close of the fiscal year containing the final financial activity
purpose: Maintain merchant-side customer and reconciliation references required for financial reporting without storing card or bank details.
review_notes: Use Stripe identifiers and minimized receipts only. Payment credentials remain with Stripe; disputes, audits, or holds extend retention.
unresolved_dependency: Finance must confirm the fiscal-year trigger and whether a longer tax or dispute period applies.

retention_trigger: Close of the fiscal year containing cancellation or final subscription activity
purpose: Retain subscription status and reconciliation evidence for the financial-record period, then minimize personal data.
review_notes: Do not treat cancellation as permission to delete unresolved invoices, refunds, disputes, tax evidence, or legal holds.
unresolved_dependency: Finance must confirm fiscal-year calculation and transaction-record linkage.

retention_trigger: End of the semester represented by the export, after all grade disputes resolve
purpose: Preserve the reconstruction evidence for a course grade export while preventing indefinite duplicate grade stores.
review_notes: If ASU designates the snapshot as an original grade sheet, permanent retention applies instead; this proposal assumes reconstruction evidence.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm snapshot is not the permanent original grade sheet and complete the Blackboard round-trip gate.

retention_trigger: Mapping superseded, integration access terminated, or account closed
purpose: Retain LMS identity mapping briefly for reconciliation and access investigations, then remove the cross-system identifier.
review_notes: Do not delete while linked grade exports or unresolved sync incidents still require the mapping.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm Blackboard institutional mapping and incident hold process.

retention_trigger: Institution-controlled Blackboard archive and deletion event
purpose: Prevent EdNotebook from claiming disposal of education records that remain in an institution-controlled Blackboard environment.
review_notes: The institution controls course archives and retention; EdNotebook must record the request, result, and residual provider copy without pretending it deleted the provider.
unresolved_dependency: Complete Blackboard round-trip and obtain the institution's Blackboard archive/deletion policy.

retention_trigger: Preference superseded or course/account relationship terminated
purpose: Keep notification and communication controls long enough to resolve delivery or consent disputes, then remove obsolete preferences.
review_notes: Current preferences remain active; superseded values should not become an indefinite behavioral profile.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm whether preference-change history is required for consent evidence.

retention_trigger: End of academic term or message disposition, whichever is later
purpose: Retain read-state evidence through the course and dispute window, then minimize fine-grained engagement metadata.
review_notes: A read receipt attached to a grievance, accommodation, grade appeal, or legal hold inherits the longer record class.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm read-state is not used as an official attendance or academic-action record.

retention_trigger: Graduation or date of last attendance
purpose: Preserve lesson completion evidence for academic-progress review and student access while limiting duplicate progress stores.
review_notes: This applies to identifiable progress. Approved de-identified aggregate outcomes may be retained separately under research/governance rules.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm that lesson progress maps to academic progress rather than transient analytics.

retention_trigger: End of the academic year in which membership is posted to the academic record
purpose: Maintain authoritative course membership evidence for roster, access, and grade reconciliation.
review_notes: Rejected or abandoned enrollment requests are handled separately; active/accepted membership changes must remain reconstructable.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm the end-of-academic-year trigger used by ASU.

retention_trigger: Graduation or date of last attendance
purpose: Retain course-level academic progress for advising, completion, and student record access.
review_notes: Research exports must be de-identified and governed separately; legal holds and access requests pause disposition.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm course progress is an academic-progress record and not the permanent transcript.

retention_trigger: Final approval, denial, withdrawal, or expiration
purpose: Preserve human verification decisions long enough for access review, fraud response, and re-application checks.
review_notes: Escalated complaints, investigations, or litigation inherit the applicable longer record class.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm verification evidence minimization and complaint escalation path.

retention_trigger: Final disposition or transfer of the requested record
purpose: Maintain durable evidence of authorized deletion, transfer, blocked disposition, and responsible actor.
review_notes: Keep metadata and outcome, not deleted file content. A failed or partial deletion must remain visible until reconciled.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm this domain is the EdNotebook disposition log and includes required ASU fields.

retention_trigger: Source deletion, preview expiry, or source replacement
purpose: Remove derived previews promptly so file deletion and access revocation are not defeated by stale copies.
review_notes: Preview deletion must cover generated bytes, metadata, signed links, and cache invalidation; legal holds apply to the source, not an unnecessary derivative.
unresolved_dependency: Verify preview workers and cache invalidation complete within the seven-day outer bound.

retention_trigger: Share revoked, expired, or underlying grade record access terminated
purpose: Retain access-grant evidence for security review, then remove obsolete tokens and mappings.
review_notes: Reusable secrets must be invalidated immediately; the period applies only to sanitized grant metadata and access evidence.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm FERPA disclosure logging is captured separately for the life of the underlying record.

retention_trigger: Final approval, denial, withdrawal, or expiration
purpose: Document identity onboarding decisions and prevent unauthorized role creation while avoiding indefinite applicant identity retention.
review_notes: If an approved request becomes the active identity record, the active identity lifecycle controls; rejected request evidence is minimized after the review window.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm linkage to account-status-specific deletion rules.

retention_trigger: Final approval, denial, withdrawal, or expiration
purpose: Retain institution-access decisions for authorization review and fraud response.
review_notes: Do not retain uploaded identity evidence when a minimized decision record is sufficient; investigations and holds override.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm evidence redaction after verification.

retention_trigger: Graduation or date of last attendance, or affiliation termination for non-students
purpose: Preserve the institutional relationship needed to interpret course and academic records.
review_notes: Non-student affiliations may require a different personnel or vendor series and must be routed before this policy applies.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm role-specific trigger and exclude employee-only records from the student matrix.

retention_trigger: Graduation or date of last attendance, or membership termination for non-students
purpose: Retain institutional membership history needed for tenant authorization and education-record interpretation.
review_notes: Current memberships are not eligible for disposition; role changes and transfers must remain reconstructable.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm student versus employee/member record classification.

retention_trigger: Final transfer disposition or graduation/date of last attendance, whichever is later
purpose: Maintain transfer decision history needed to reconcile tenant ownership and student access.
review_notes: Rejected and withdrawn requests may be minimized sooner only after Records approves a distinct series.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm mapping to add/drop or change-of-status series.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until message record classes are separated
purpose: Prevent deletion of messages that may constitute routine chatter, academic feedback, accommodation evidence, grievances, or legal records.
review_notes: Content and context determine retention. A single global day count would either over-retain private messages or destroy required records.
unresolved_dependency: Classify messages at creation and provide escalation to grievance, appeal, accommodation, research, and legal-hold series.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until ownership and record-copy status are captured
record_series: Mixed course records / student work / publications
purpose: Protect course materials, licensed resources, and student-created content from an unsafe one-size-fits-all disposal rule.
review_notes: Instructor course materials may be course records, student uploads may be coursework, and published resources may carry IP or archival duties.
unresolved_dependency: Add resource type, owner, license, official-copy flag, and archival review metadata.

retention_trigger: Identifier superseded or integration/account access terminated
purpose: Retain cross-system identifier evidence for reconciliation, then remove obsolete identifiers.
review_notes: Do not delete while active mappings, grade synchronization, disputes, or incident investigations depend on the identifier.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm every upstream/downstream system participates in deprovisioning.

retention_trigger: Written legal-hold release and subsequent records-authorized disposition
purpose: Make legal-hold content ineligible for automated deletion until counsel releases the hold.
review_notes: After release, the file returns to its underlying record-series policy; the hold itself is not a new permanent retention period.
unresolved_dependency: Require written release, underlying-domain linkage, and disposition authorization.

retention_trigger: Source link removal, preview expiry, or last governed reference
purpose: Remove cached link metadata and images that are no longer needed for the active learning record.
review_notes: Do not copy private page content beyond what is needed for the preview; source deletion and access revocation must invalidate derivatives.
unresolved_dependency: Verify crawler/cache deletion and prohibit sensitive-source snapshots.

retention_trigger: End of the academic year in which membership is posted to the academic record
purpose: Preserve LTI context membership evidence for roster and grade reconciliation.
review_notes: Only minimum LTI claims should be retained; provider copies remain under the platform's separate policy.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm context-to-course mapping and institutional record-copy designation.

retention_trigger: End of semester after successful reconciliation and resolution of grade disputes
purpose: Maintain grade synchronization evidence sufficient to reconstruct and audit grade transmission.
review_notes: Sanitize payloads; retain identifiers, status, timestamps, hashes, and failure reason rather than duplicate response bodies.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm whether any event is the original grade sheet, which would require permanent retention.

retention_trigger: Launch session expiry, revocation, or nonce replay window closure
purpose: Remove expired LTI launch state promptly while preserving only sanitized incident metadata.
review_notes: Never retain reusable launch tokens or full identity claims beyond operational need; security incidents route to audit evidence.
unresolved_dependency: Verify launch-state cleanup, nonce TTL, and log sanitization.

retention_trigger: Platform-owned deletion/archive event with verified result
purpose: Prevent EdNotebook from asserting deletion of education records held by an external LTI platform or tool.
review_notes: Contract, platform configuration, and tool-specific deletion behavior govern the external copy; EdNotebook records requests and outcomes.
unresolved_dependency: Inventory each LTI tool, DPA, retention rule, export path, and deletion confirmation.

retention_trigger: Mapping superseded or LTI/account access terminated
purpose: Retain mapping evidence for access reconciliation and then remove obsolete cross-system identifiers.
review_notes: Do not delete while active courses, grade sync, disputes, or security investigations depend on the mapping.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm upstream and downstream mapping deletion procedures.

retention_trigger: Terminal job completion, cancellation, or permanent failure
purpose: Retain sanitized job status briefly for retry and incident analysis, then remove payload-bearing operational copies.
review_notes: Prompt, file, and provider response bodies must not be persisted in job records; incidents route to the audit/security series.
unresolved_dependency: Verify dead-letter, retry, and worker logs obey the same boundary.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until student-status-specific and record-copy rules exist
record_series: ASU account schedule / student record series
purpose: Avoid both premature deletion of student identity context and indefinite retention after the institution's account window.
review_notes: Profile rows participate in mixed foreign-key behavior and different student-status windows. Anonymization must preserve required academic references without retaining unnecessary PII.
unresolved_dependency: Design status-aware deprovisioning and field-level anonymization; validate every foreign-key effect.

retention_trigger: Provider backup creation; expiry is rolling
purpose: Document the unavoidable rolling backup residual after primary deletion and keep it within the contracted provider window.
review_notes: Supabase Pro exposes seven days of daily backups; database backups exclude Storage bytes. Holds requiring longer preservation need an authorized separate record copy.
unresolved_dependency: Verify project plan/configuration quarterly and document that Storage backups are separate.

retention_trigger: Close of the fiscal year containing entitlement expiry, refund, or final transaction
purpose: Preserve purchase, rental, refund, and access-right evidence needed for customer service and financial reconciliation.
review_notes: Free academic entitlements that become official course participation records must also link to the course-membership lifecycle.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm fiscal-year trigger and separation of free academic versus commercial entitlements.

retention_trigger: Later of academic-term end, user export window, dispute resolution, or legal-hold release
purpose: Preserve student annotations for learning and export while limiting retention of identifiable student-authored notes.
review_notes: User-initiated deletion may occur earlier when no submission, grading, research, dispute, or hold dependency exists.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm annotation export notice and whether professor-visible annotations become assessed coursework.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until every file has a governed record class
purpose: Prevent deletion or over-retention of files whose obligations depend on whether they are coursework, grades, research, accessibility, financial, publication, or legal records.
review_notes: Bucket location is not a record series. Each file needs owner, institution, record class, trigger date, official-copy flag, hold state, and disposition result.
unresolved_dependency: Add mandatory record-class metadata and deny unclassified production uploads.

retention_trigger: Origin object deletion or replacement
purpose: Ensure access revocation and source deletion propagate to delivery caches within a conservative outer bound.
review_notes: Supabase reports CDN invalidation can take up to 60 seconds; browser cache TTL is separate, so private objects require short cache control and origin deletion.
unresolved_dependency: Verify private-object cache headers, signed-URL behavior, and deletion evidence.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until version inherits the source record class
purpose: Prevent old object versions from outliving the governed source record or being deleted while the source is under hold.
review_notes: Supabase database backups do not restore Storage bytes. Version and backup design must be explicit, and deletion must use the Storage API.
unresolved_dependency: Bind every version to source record class, trigger, legal hold, and verified byte deletion.

retention_trigger: Successful signature verification, idempotent processing, and reconciliation
purpose: Keep webhook data only for the provider's full-event troubleshooting window and avoid a duplicate long-lived payment-data store.
review_notes: Store event ID, type, account, status, timestamps, and sanitized error metadata where possible; redact full payloads earlier after reconciliation.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm no tax, dispute, or accounting evidence exists only inside the webhook payload.

retention_trigger: Final disposition of the parent subject request
purpose: Maintain an auditable item-by-item record of access, correction, export, deletion, block, and residual-copy outcomes.
review_notes: Retain decision metadata and evidence, not unnecessary copies of the student's underlying records.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm the item log contains required ASU disposition fields and links contested-record statements for the life of the record.

retention_trigger: Final disposition of the request
purpose: Preserve accountable evidence that student access, correction, export, and deletion requests were received and resolved.
review_notes: Outstanding access requests prohibit destruction of requested education records; appeals or litigation extend retention.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm workflow timing, identity verification, and disposition-log fields.

retention_trigger: Graduation or date of last attendance
purpose: Retain the governed academic pathway used for advising and progress interpretation.
review_notes: Permanent transcript outcomes should be stored in the institution's official academic record, not inferred from this operational path.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm which fields are advising records versus permanent academic records.

retention_trigger: Final enrollment decision or graduation/date of last attendance, whichever is later
purpose: Preserve approval, denial, and enrollment-change evidence needed to reconstruct course access.
review_notes: Abandoned requests may qualify for a shorter series only after Records approves and the system distinguishes them.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm trigger and handling of never-enrolled applicants.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until EdNotebook's grade record role is designated
purpose: Prevent destruction of permanent original grade sheets or indefinite duplication of course grade books.
review_notes: ASU retains grade books four years after semester end but original grade sheets permanently. The institution must state which role EdNotebook serves.
unresolved_dependency: Obtain written record-copy designation and grade-export/round-trip evidence.

retention_trigger: End of academic year or graduation/date of last attendance, whichever the mapped course series requires
purpose: Preserve assessed group membership needed to interpret submissions, peer work, and grading.
review_notes: Non-assessed social groups may qualify for a shorter course-record period once the system distinguishes them.
unresolved_dependency: Classify academic versus optional social group memberships.

retention_trigger: End of semester in which the group was used
purpose: Retain course group structure long enough to interpret course content and then remove obsolete operational grouping.
review_notes: Group membership evidence follows its separate five-year proposal; public or archived organizations require separate classification.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm groups are course structures and not official student-organization archives.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until learning-record subtypes are separated
purpose: Prevent one aggregate domain from deleting permanent achievement records or over-retaining transient learning evidence.
review_notes: Credentials, final academic status, progress telemetry, attempts, and activities require different dispositions and triggers.
unresolved_dependency: Split permanent outcomes, five-year progress, one-year coursework, and de-identified research measures.

retention_trigger: Later of academic-term end, moderation/grievance closure, or legal-hold release
purpose: Retain assessed discussion content through the course-work and dispute window, then minimize identifiable student posts.
review_notes: Publications, student-organization archives, research data, and misconduct/grievance records must be reclassified before deletion.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm platform social posts can be distinguished from assessed course discussions.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until directory-information and account-status rules are represented
purpose: Prevent disclosure or over-retention of student profile data when directory opt-out and account lifecycle differ by user status.
review_notes: Public visibility is not proof that data is non-sensitive. Annual directory notice/opt-out and institution-specific fields control disclosure.
unresolved_dependency: Implement directory opt-out, status-aware deletion, and field-level anonymization.

retention_trigger: End of academic year in which roster data is posted to transcripts
purpose: Maintain authoritative roster evidence for enrollment, access, completion, and grade reconciliation.
review_notes: Corrections must be versioned or auditable; legal holds and outstanding access requests pause disposition.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm EdNotebook roster is record copy or governed convenience copy.

retention_trigger: Final response, withdrawal, or thirty days of abandonment
purpose: Respond to prospective-user interest without creating an indefinite shadow profile for a person who never establishes an account.
review_notes: Collect minimum contact data, provide notice, suppress marketing without retaining the full submission, and route actual applications to their governed domain.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm consent language and suppression-list design.

retention_trigger: Reservation expiry, consumption, or cancellation
purpose: Remove temporary quota locks and associated user metadata promptly after the upload decision.
review_notes: A successful upload's governed file record replaces the reservation; failures retain only sanitized troubleshooting evidence.
unresolved_dependency: Verify scheduled cleanup and abandoned multipart-upload handling.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until contract, ownership, publication, and archival status are captured
record_series: Mixed publication / course record / intellectual property
purpose: Protect professor and publisher works from deletion that violates ownership, licensing, sale, student-access, or archival obligations.
review_notes: Withdrawal from sale does not necessarily delete purchased entitlements or institutional course copies. Interactive books can also contain student education records.
unresolved_dependency: Approve author agreement, rights/version policy, archival rule, and purchased-access survival.

retention_trigger: No automatic trigger until academic and commercial entitlement types are separated
purpose: Prevent free assigned-course access records and paid purchase/rental rights from receiving an unsafe shared retention rule.
review_notes: Academic entitlements follow enrollment/roster rules; paid entitlements follow financial and contract rules; current perpetual rights cannot expire by retention job.
unresolved_dependency: Split academic, free-public, purchase, rental, refund, and perpetual entitlement types.

retention_trigger: Policy superseded or account/institution access terminated
purpose: Retain authorization-policy history long enough to explain access decisions and investigate misuse.
review_notes: Current policy stays active; secrets are excluded; security incidents and disclosure records inherit longer applicable series.
unresolved_dependency: Confirm version history and linkage to access-decision audit events.
